response_corrections.NH_original_heading: MS_Response was confirmed by the author to denote UV response
response_corrections.base_label: CsOH/2 was confirmed by the author to denote CsOH

initialization.sampling: without replacement from all 13920 candidate conditions
initialization.record: The twelve distinct round-0 indices in each deposited trajectory are the recorded initialization batch.

acquisition.scope: All unselected candidates in the 13920-condition decision space
acquisition.batch_mode: Simultaneous top4; the next saved update uses the complete four-response batch
acquisition.tie_breaking: 13920 PCG64 uniform jitter draws scaled by 1e-12, stable argsort

model.type: Hierarchical Gaussian process with conjugate variance-scale update
model.standardization: Mean and population SD of the currently selected responses; scale=1 if SD<=1e-12
model.latent_uncertainty_interpretation: The displayed +/-2 latent posterior SD reports model uncertainty across the full 13920-condition space.

stopping.rule: At the first completed round with n>=24 and initial_SD>1e-12 and best(n)-best(n-8)<=0.1*initial_SD

execution.campaign_loop: For each saved round, fit the surrogate to responses assigned through the preceding completed round, record four recommendations and four measured responses, then save the next model update.
execution.feedback: Saved updates assimilate complete four-response batches; partial-batch updates are absent from the deposited histories.
execution.source_resolution: For repeated condition keys in the deposited response ledger, complete-condition-grid records take precedence over catalyst-panel records. No averaging or maximum-response selection.

record_provenance.sequential_consistency: The saved histories and replay use only responses assigned through the preceding completed round.
record_provenance.duplicate_interpretation: Each conflict-table row is a distinct source record. Shared encoded condition keys may omit plate, batch or analytical differences.

experimental_record_context.scope_volume_note: Numerical scope records are predominantly 500 uL. Legacy NH records AP001-AP003 retain their original 250 uL source-screen scale.
experimental_record_context.volume_layer_scope: Source-screen and BO/scope volumes are reported as distinct experimental layers.

condition_context.comparison: NH and OH Table 1/scope settings differ from the recorded BO highest-response settings; SH matches. The scope settings are not collectively the three BO maxima.

post_run_verification.purpose: Recompute each recorded campaign history and check the saved recommendations, measured UV responses, posterior quantities and first stopping decision.
post_run_verification.scope: Integrity verification that each recorded initialization contains twelve distinct indices in the 13920-condition space, followed by full-space ranking of every later recommendation using measured feedback assigned through each completed round.

method_reference.description: Prior GP-based reaction condition recommendation and random-screening comparison; current batch size, kernel and UCB settings are specified here.
